marta (docs): small follow-up thread. PR 4140 will tweak the model catalog limits doc. Need an explicit line about max tokens per-request vs windowed streaming. Suggested wording: 'API enforces per-request max_input_tokens; for longer contexts use streaming with chunked inputs and KV-cache.' Thoughts? Link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4140
ales (eng-ml): Agree. Add example: streaming + kv-cache header flags in curl. Also call out that Dedicated pools can have increased 'window' settings.
dani (devex): I'll prepare a tiny node example showing how to do chunked uploads and stitch outputs with streaming.
marta (docs): Keep it <15 lines. Also add a one-line note about 'limits vary by quantization profile' (sam/ales to confirm).
ales (eng-ml): Confirmed: q4h may have lower effective window because of kernel fallback; wording: 'Effective window may vary by quantization profile and runtime; consult model card.'
dani (devex): node snippet:
```js
const chunks = [...]; // split input
for (const c of chunks) {
  const resp = await fetch(...);
  // append streaming pieces client-side
}
```
nathan (product): Also add an inline link to the 'rolling upgrades' note — customers on Dedicated may see perf changes during kernel upgrades. single-sentence cross-ref is fine.
marta (docs): ok I'll fold all these into PR 4140 and push. Will ask for final read by EOD.
docs-bot: PR 4140 updated by @marta  reviewers requested: @ales, @dani
